name: How does the cost of a metal roof upgrade compare to other roofing materials?

mainEntity.name: How does the cost of a metal roof upgrade compare to other roofing materials?

acceptedAnswer.text: Initially, a metal roof upgrade typically has a higher upfront cost than asphalt shingles. However, its longevity, often lasting 40-70 years, and minimal maintenance requirements can result in lower lifetime costs. Additionally, the energy efficiency of metal roofs can lead to savings on utility bills over time. Customers in DFW and surrounding areas should compare the initial investment with potential long-term savings.
acceptedAnswer.description: Metal roofs have higher initial costs than asphalt shingles but offer lower lifetime costs due to their long lifespan and energy efficiency.
